metadata.description: Free Amazon-seller tools from Method Press. Diagnostics and helpers that pair with the Amazon Brand Launch Bundle.

plugins.name: method-press-acos-health-check
plugins.description: A free Amazon Sponsored Products PPC diagnostic. Computes ACoS, break-even ACoS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, and CPC, then walks a five-cause diagnostic to tell you which lever is actually the problem — targeting, bid, price, reviews, or the listing. Dual-mode (Amazon Ads MCP or paste-in). Read-only.
